question: Based on Landsat B10 thermal infrared data of Lake Ontario (2022-12-16), derive the mean surface water temperature in Celsius.
final_answer_preview:
The mean surface water temperature of Lake Ontario on 2022-12-16, derived from Landsat B10 thermal infrared data, is **-16.3°C**.
